frontPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: sixteen-piece modular game character atlas.
Rebuild the Crown Militia from reference1 as original modern high-end game art. Reference1 determines identity/clothing; reference2 supplies only the modular4x4 layout and quality. Keep this lighter militia distinct from heavy royal guards.
An able-bodied adult man about30, short brown beard and practical brown hair under a simple dark iron bowl helmet with a narrow brass center band and riveted rim, face open. Plain cream linen tunic and sleeves under a dark brown leather sleeveless jerkin, deep royal-blue diagonal cloth sash, brown belt with small pouch, knee-length cream split tunic skirts with blue gold-edged heraldic cloth panels, fitted charcoal trousers, dark leather bracers and brown tall boots. Modest functional equipment, NO plated cuirass, no oversized shoulders. His short mace is right-handed and small round blue shield left-handed, but NEITHER prop appears in this body atlas.
Premium realistic3D game sculpture, lifelike adult proportions and skin, detailed linen/leather/forged iron, warm upper-left key and cool bounce. FRONT view, orthographic camera25degrees above horizontal.
Exactly16 isolated pieces, regular4columns×4rows, generous transparent gutters. No assembled figure.
Row1: front head+neck including helmet and face; armless torso shoulders-to-waist including leather jerkin over cream underlying tunic and blue sash, NO sleeves/head; belt/pouch/cream split hip garment and blue heraldic panels, NO legs; detached small leather pouch as unused alternate accessory.
Row2: LEFT UPPER ARM shoulder-to-elbow, plain cream linen only, NO bracer and NO forearm; RIGHT UPPER ARM same; LEFT FOREARM elbow-to-wrist cream cuff and dark leather bracer, NO hand; RIGHT FOREARM same.
Row3: LEFT closed gripping hand+wrist; RIGHT closed gripping hand+wrist; exactly ONE LEFT trouser THIGH hip-to-knee; exactly ONE RIGHT trouser THIGH. Never two legs or shorts per cell.
Row4: LEFT trouser SHIN knee-to-ankle, NO boot, NO foot; RIGHT trouser SHIN, NO boot, NO foot; LEFT separate boot, toes facing camera; RIGHT separate boot toes facing camera.
Limb shafts straight down with invisible round overlap caps, no bends baked in. Hands gently closed with fingers curled and small empty thumb/index hole for an invisible shaft.
Torso shoulder surfaces are solid continuous cream linen at attachment areas, smoothly inside the torso outline. NO exposed skin circle, NO hollow black armhole, NO attached sleeve stub. Separate upper-arm pieces provide sleeves.
No weapons, shield, cargo, cape, scenery, floor, shadows, text, labels, grid, checkerboard or backgroundcolor. Genuine transparent PNG RGBA blankspace alpha0.

extractionPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
